about: Buildings that the data tags as a place of worship and that are not to be drawn as one (v2/data/scene/worship.py; facades.md rule 14). One entry per OSM outline: its id, the reason, the date and the owner's words. A listed outline makes no building a church: its buildings keep the house rule. Add an entry here rather than changing the rule; the list stays short.

not_drawn_as_worship.place: the building beside St Michael's, rue Sigefroi (no name in OSM)
not_drawn_as_worship.reason: OSM tags it building=church, with a note asking whether it has been turned into flats. Drawn as a stone church with tall windows it read wrong beside St Michael's; it goes back to the house rule.
